title: The Butcher's Masquerade
author: Matt Dinniman
summary: The fifth Dungeon Crawler Carl book. Still trapped in the game, the crawlers face a new, more dangerous stage in which the show's audience and sponsors have their own plans for them.
readIf: you have followed Carl and Donut this far and want the series to keep escalating.
skipIf: you want a gentle read or have not started the series.

pairings.reason: A grittier, more stylised vision of technology and power run amok, for readers who like the series for its world rather than the jokes.
Another very long series where each book expands the cast and the scale, with a serious, epic tone.
Military science fiction with a wry voice, where an ordinary person is thrown into a hostile, alien-filled universe.
